title: The Straightforward answer to the question
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：straightforward　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 straightforward 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the grower wrote of ① a straightforward answer to the question in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② so straightforward that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the straightforward ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the straightforward answer to the question that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too straightforward to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the straightforward ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a straightforward man at the counter, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as straightforward as the man at the counter they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was straightforward or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something straightforward, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite straightforward; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the straightforward ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, before dawn, she wrote of another straightforward answer to the question in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ no less straightforward than anybody had expected. ⑩ The straightforward man at the counter that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the straightforward ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 简单明了（前置定语 a straightforward answer to the question：1959 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件简单明了的回答）
B. adj. 简单明了／坦率（两处加强说法：so straightforward that … 与 no less straightforward than …）
C. adj. 简单明了／坦率（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 简单明了（表语 too straightforward to do：母亲觉得它太简单明了，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 坦率（前置定语 a straightforward man at the counter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩坦率的男人）
F. adj. 坦率（同级比较 as straightforward as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩柜台后坦率的男人相比）
G. adj. 坦率（后置定语 something straightforward：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 坦率（受程度副词修饰 quite straightforward：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a straightforward answer to the question
the straightforward answer to the question that
a straightforward man at the counter
The straightforward man at the counter that

answers.why: straightforward 意为“简单明了”，1959 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件简单明了的回答”，此处作前置定语 a straightforward answer to the question。
straightforward 意为“简单明了”，此处用 so straightforward that 结构，说它简单明了到大棚里没人敢靠近。
straightforward 意为“简单明了”，收成账上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的简单明了简单明了的回答，等于最高级的说法。
straightforward 意为“简单明了”，母亲认为这件东西“太简单明了了，谁也用不上”，too straightforward to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
straightforward 意为“坦率”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩坦率的男人”，此处作前置定语 a straightforward man at the counter。
straightforward 意为“坦率”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩柜台后坦率的男人一样坦率”，同级比较用 as straightforward as。
straightforward 意为“坦率”，收成账上那半行字要的是“坦率的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something straightforward。
straightforward 意为“坦率”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当坦率”，quite 修饰原级 straightforward。
straightforward 意为“坦率”，no less straightforward than 表示“其坦率不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之坦率不亚于任何人的预料。
straightforward 意为“坦率”，母亲 1971 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的坦率男人”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件简单明了的回答。（a straightforward answer to the question）
它简单明了到大棚里没有一个人敢靠近。（so straightforward that …）
母亲觉得它太简单明了，谁也用不上。（too straightforward to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩坦率的男人。（a straightforward man at the counter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩柜台后坦率的男人一样坦率。（as straightforward as …）
到了 1966 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件坦率的东西。（something straightforward）
answers: In 1959 the grower wrote of a straightforward answer to the question in the ledger.
It was so straightforward that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it.
My mother thought it too straightforward to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a straightforward man at the counter.
He said nobody would call it as straightforward as the man at the counter they had once had.
By 1966 the ledger asked for nothing but something straightforward.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 straightforward 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the grower wrote of a straightforward answer to the question in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the straightforward answer to the question that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too straightforward to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a straightforward man at the counter, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite straightforward, and everybody laughed.
The straightforward ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
